scope: Specification only. Execute each mutation in a fresh private source copy. Require exactly the selected test to compile and fail; compiler failure, zero tests, unexpected failures, timeout or unchanged passing output reject the control. These tests use only synthetic channels, egui state and callback workers; no device, UI application, settings files or network.

controls.name: stale-update-retagged-at-mailbox
controls.oracle: A frame authored under the captured old key must not become a new-generation mailbox request. The App sent cache must remain at its prior value and the gate must close after refusal.

controls.name: owned-legacy-bus2-refusal-disabled
controls.old: CtrlMsg::Legacy { bus: BUS_MIXER, .. } if owned_mixer => None,
controls.new: CtrlMsg::Legacy { bus: BUS_MIXER, .. } if false && owned_mixer => None,
controls.oracle: Raw bus2 bytes in owned mode must yield no legacy cache entry. Disabling the classifier refusal incorrectly admits those bytes for legacy replay.

controls.name: failed-mailbox-enqueue-advances-app-cache
controls.oracle: An in-flight request consumes the mailbox bound. A refused subsequent frame must not advance the App deduplication cache; terminal stop is tested in the same selected case.

controls.name: app-exit-omits-terminal-stop
controls.new: if let Some(_port) = &self.links.mixer { /* mutant omits terminal stop */ }
controls.oracle: Actual App on_exit must request terminal admission stop. Retaining the old captured key after exit must not allow a new mailbox enqueue or deduplication-cache advance. The fixture still owns explicit stop and join cleanup.

controls.name: busy-confirmation-discards-staged-baseline
controls.oracle: A one-shot test-only local mutex holder forces the actual mailbox try_lock WouldBlock branch, and drops before App handles Busy. The exact staged receipt must remain and reject a false release as HeldControls; reverting to close returns NoBaseline and fails immediately, without treating timeout as a successful control.
